charts.title: Leading fitness markets in Europe in 2019, by market share
charts.short: Market share of leading fitness markets in Europe 2019
charts.description: This statistic displays the leading fitness markets in Europe in 2018, by market share. Germany and the United Kingdom exhibited the greatest share of the fitness market occupying 20 percent each.

charts.title: Revenue of the fitness industry in the United Kingdom from 2019 to 2021 (in billion euros)
charts.short: United Kingdom: revenue of the fitness market 2015-2021
charts.description: The revenue of the fitness market in the United Kingdom fell significantly between 2019 and 2020. This was as a result of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, which forced the closure of many gyms across the country. In 2021, the industry showed signs of recovery, with revenue in the market reaching 3.56 billion euros.

charts.title: Market size of the gym, health & fitness clubs industry in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2012 to 2022 (in million GBP)
charts.short: Gym, health & fitness club industry market size in the United Kingdom (UK) 2012-2022
charts.description: Every day, thousands of fitness fanatics hit the gym to keep in shape. However, the coronavirus pandemic which swept across the world in 2020 had a significant impact on the fitness industry as many establishments were forced to close their doors to stem the spread of the disease. While the market size of the fitness club industry in the United Kingdom grew to above two billion British pounds in the years leading up the pandemic, forecasts suggest that the value of the industry will fall to [...]
charts.note: United Kingdom; 2012 to 2022; * Forecast Read more

charts.title: Market size of the personal training industry in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2011 to 2022 (in million British pounds)
charts.short: Personal training market size in the United Kingdom (UK) 2011-2022
charts.description: The personal training market in the United Kingdom saw a steady increase between 2011 and 2020, before declining abruptly in 2021. Notably, the market size of the personal trainers sector declined by about 25 percent in 2021. However, the industry is expected to grow by about 18 percent in 2022.

charts.title: Gross value added (GVA) of fitness facilities in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2008 to 2021 (in million GBP)
charts.short: Gross value added (GVA) of fitness facilities in the United Kingdom (UK) 2008-2021
charts.description: In 2021, fitness facilities contributed approximately 818 million British pounds to the GVA of the UK Non-Financial Business Economy. This represented a significant decrease on the figure from two years earlier, no doubt due to the impact of the coronavirus pandemic on fitness facilities.

charts.title: Number of gyms and fitness centres in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2011 to 2022
charts.short: Number of gyms in the United Kingdom (UK) 2011-2022
charts.description: The number of gyms and fitness centres in the United Kingdom more than doubled between 2011 and 2020, highlighting the booming fitness market within the country. However, the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic in 2020 created significant challenges for this growing industry as many health and fitness establishments were forced to close their doors to the public. As a result, the number of gyms in the United Kingdom fell from 3,654 in 2020 to 3,060 in 2021. Despite this, the number [...]

charts.title: Number of members at gyms and fitness clubs in the United Kingdom from 2019 to 2021 (in millions)
charts.short: Number of gym members in the UK 2019-2021
charts.description: The number of people with memberships to gyms in the United Kingdom saw an increase between 2020 and 2021. In the latter year, just over 9.57 million people had gym memberships in the UK. However, this was following a steep drop in the number of members between 2019 and 2020 as a result of the impact of the coronavirus (COVID-19) on gyms.

charts.title: Number of fitness clubs in the largest low-cost health and fitness club groups in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2013 to 2019
charts.short: UK: number of gyms in the largest low-cost health and fitness groups 2013-2019
charts.description: This statistic displays the number of gyms in the largest low-cost health and fitness club groups in the United Kingdom from 2013 to 2019. From 2013 to 2019, the number of clubs in the largest private low-cost fitness club groups increased from 196 to 727. The revenue of the health club industry amounted to a value of around 6.2 billion U.S. dollars in the UK in 2015. Further information on the fitness industry in the UK can be found in the Dossier: Fitness industry in the United Kingdom.

charts.title: Number of The Gym Group health clubs in the United Kingdom from 2012 to 2023
charts.short: Number of The Gym Group locations in the UK 2012-2023
charts.description: Founded in 2007, The Gym Group is a chain of 24/7 fitness clubs with locations across the United Kingdom. The company had 230 sites in 2023, a significant increase on the number of locations in 2016.

charts.title: Number of Fitness First gyms in the United Kingdom as of May 2023, by location
charts.short: Number of Fitness First locations in the UK 2023, by city
charts.description: Founded in 1993 in the United Kingdom, Fitness First had 34 locations in the country as of May 2023. The majority of these locations were in London, while there was also a Fitness First gym in Wigan.

charts.title: Number of Anytime Fitness gyms in the United Kingdom as of May 2023, by location
charts.short: Number of Anytime Fitness locations in the UK 2023, by city
charts.description: Founded in 2002, Anytime Fitness had 190 gyms across the United Kingdom as of May 2023. Of these locations, 20 were found in London, while Birmingham was home to two Anytime Fitness gyms.

charts.title: Number of David Lloyd gyms in the United Kingdom as of May 2023, by location
charts.short: Number of David Lloyd locations in the UK 2023, by city
charts.description: Founded in 1982 in the United Kingdom, David Lloyd Leisure had 99 locations in the country as of April 2023. The city with the most David Lloyd gyms was London with seven, while there were three David Lloyd clubs in Bristol.

charts.title: Number of enterprises in the operation of fitness facilities in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2015 to 2020, by employment size band
charts.short: Number of fitness facilities operating in the UK 2015-2020, by employees
charts.description: This statistic shows the number of VAT and/or PAYE based enterprises in the operation of fitness facilities in the United Kingdom from 2015 to 2020, by employment size band. In March 2020, there were 15 fitness facility enterprises employing between 100 and 249 employees.
charts.note: United Kingdom; 2015 to 2020; VAT and/or PAYE based enterprises

charts.title: Estimated number of people working in sports and fitness occupations in the United Kingdom from 4th quarter 2021 to 4th quarter 2023
charts.short: Number of people working in sports and fitness occupations in the UK 2021-2023
charts.description: There were estimated to be approximately 174,600 sport and fitness working in the United Kingdom as of the fourth quarter of 2023, compared with 165,300 in the previous quarter.

charts.title: Estimated number of fitness and wellness instructors in the United Kingdom from 4th quarter 2021 to 2nd quarter 2023
charts.short: Number of fitness instructors in the UK 2021-2023
charts.description: There were estimated to be approximately 57,900 fitness instructors working in the United Kingdom as of the second quarter of 2023, compared with 60,900 in the previous quarter.

charts.title: Number of personal trainers in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2011 to 2022
charts.short: Number of personal trainers in the United Kingdom (UK) 2011-2022
charts.description: Trying to keep fit can be a constant battle, with many people in the United Kingdom turning to personal trainers to help them keep in shape. In 2011, there were just over 15 thousand personal trainers in the UK, a figure which rose to over 23 thousand by 2020. However, the coronavirus pandemic in 2020 posed a significant threat to this growing industry as many health and fitness establishments were forced to close their doors to the public, resulting in the decline of personal trainer [...]

charts.title: Gender distribution of sports and fitness occupations in the United Kingdom (UK) in 2021, by employment status
charts.short: Gender distribution of sports and fitness occupations by employment status 2021
charts.description: In 2021, over 168 thousand people worked in the field of sports and fitness in the United Kingdom (UK), 80 thousand of which were classified as part-time positions and the remaining 87.8 thousand classified as full-time. Male employees occupied around 55 percent of these positions, the majority of whom were employed in a full time position.
charts.note: United Kingdom; October 2020 to September 2021; Currently in employment

charts.title: Number of people participating in fitness classes in England from 2015 to 2023
charts.short: Fitness class participation England 2015-2023
charts.description: Between November 2022 to November 2023, approximately 6.2 million people participated in fitness classes in England. This marked an increase from the number of participants two years earlier, which stood at over approximately 5.8 million.
charts.note: United Kingdom (England); 2015 to 2023; 172,968 respondents; 16 years and older; base varies

charts.title: Number of people participating in generic fitness training in England from 2017 to 2023
charts.short: Generic fitness training participation England 2017-2023
charts.description: The number of people participating in generic fitness training in England decreased in 2023 over the previous year. Overall, about 1.84 million individuals incorporated generic fitness training into their exercise routines in 2023, which was about 30 thousand less participants than in 2022.
charts.note: United Kingdom (England); 2017 to 2023; 172,968 respondents; 16 years and older; base varies

charts.title: Number of people who participated in fitness activities at least twice in the last 28 days in England from 2017 to 2021 (in millions)
charts.short: England: number of fitness activity participants 2017-2021
charts.description: The statistic displays the number of people who participated in fitness activities at least twice in the last 28 days in England from 2017 to 2021. As of November 2021, approximately 11.37 million people in England participated in fitness activities with at least moderate intensity for more than 150 minutes a week.
charts.note: United Kingdom (England); November 2020 to November 2021; 16 years and older

charts.title: Shares of adults who participated in selected sports in the past four weeks in Scotland from 2014 to 2019
charts.short: Scotland: share of adults sport participation 2014-2019
charts.description: An annual household survey by the Scottish government determined that swimming is the most common practiced type of sport in Scotland, with 17 percent of respondents stating that they went swimming in the four weeks prior to being questioned. Next after swimming, keep fit and aerobics as well as multigym and weight training were the most regular sports for Scottish people to participate in.

charts.description: This statistic displays the share of adults meeting physical activity guidelines in Scotland in 2022, by gender and age. charts.title: Leading health and fitness apps in the Google Play Store in Great Britain in September 2022, by revenue (in U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Leading Android health apps in Great Britain 2022, by revenue
charts.description: In September 2022, Fitbit was the leading health and fitness app in Great Britain based on revenues generated from Android users. The app generated approximately 261 thousand U.S. dollars in revenue. Strava ranked second, with a revenue of roughly 261 thousand U.S. dollars. Calorie Counter ranked third, generating more than 158 thousand U.S. dollars in revenues.
charts.note: United Kingdom (Great Britain); September 2022; based on total revenue in Google Play Store generated in Great Britain.

charts.title: Leading health and fitness apps in the Google Play Store in Great Britain in September 2022, by number of downloads

charts.description: In September 2022, Samsung Health was the leading health and fitness mobile app in the Google Play Store in Great Britain, with over 72.7 thousand downloads onto British devices. Huawei Health ranked second, with over 66 thousand downloads onto Android devices during the examined period.
charts.note: United Kingdom (Great Britain); September 2022; based on downloads to devices in Great Britain.

charts.title: Forecast for the number of online users in the eServices market by segment in the United Kingdom from 2023 to 2030 (in million)
charts.short: Forecast for the number of users in the eServices market by segment in the United Kingdom until 2030
charts.description: Over the last two observations, the number of users is forecast to significantly increase in all segments. Comparing the three different segments for the year 2030, the segment 'Event Tickets' leads the ranking with 19.62 million users. Contrastingly, 'Dating Services' is ranked last, with 8.36 million users. Their difference, compared to Event Tickets, lies at 11.26 million users.

charts.title: Forecast for the average revenue per online user for the eServices market by segment in the United Kingdom from 2023 to 2030 (in U.S. dollars)
charts.short: ARPU forecast for the eServices market by segment in the United Kingdom until 2030
charts.description: The average revenue per user (ARPU) is forecast to experience significant growth in all segments in 2030. Concerning the three selected segments, the segment Event Tickets has the largest average revenue per user (ARPU) with 266.29 U.S. dollars. Contrastingly, Dating Services is ranked last, with 40.32 U.S. dollars. Their difference, compared to Event Tickets, lies at 225.97 U.S. dollars.
